official.tuition_coverage_note: Full or partial tuition waiver, living stipend, housing, and medical insurance.
benefits: Annual renewal subject to passing the annual scholarship review
eligibility: Meets the pertinent admission requirements for international students of Peking University
Has successfully submitted an application for the current year's full-time self-funded graduate programme as an international student of Peking University
Has not received any other scholarship from the Chinese government or Peking University (with the exception of one-time non-renewable merit awards)
Is not a candidate in a joint training programme
requirements: Secure admission-track standing by first submitting the full-time self-funded international graduate programme application
Complete the Peking University online scholarship application in the Peking University International Student Service System (one application only, considered for multiple scholarship categories)
Complete the China Scholarship Council application in the CSC system; the CSC system allows only one major per applicant
Use institution code 10001 and application programme type Type B
Upload official transcripts of past educational experiences and other supporting documents
Download item 6 of the materials, the Certificate for CSC Advanced Graduate Program Application, from the Application Status page of the PKU system from 25 February
documents: Application materials listed in Attachment 2: List of Application Materials for Chinese Government Scholarship, including the Certificate for CSC Advanced Graduate Program Application (item 6)
Official transcripts of past educational experiences
Where items 11 and 12 of the CSC materials list are not applicable: the Foreigner Physical Examination Statement and the No Criminal Record Self-Declaration with personal signature
selection_criteria: One PKU application is considered automatically for the Chinese Government Scholarship for Advanced Graduate Program, the Peking University Scholarship (PKUS) and the Beijing Government Scholarship; only one scholarship is ultimately awarded
Final decisions are based on the merits of applicants who applied as new students
Renewable on an annual basis provided the holder passes the annual scholarship review
application_method: Log onto the Peking University International Student Service System at http://www.studyatpku.com, select Home - Scholarship Application - Application for Prospective Students, fill in the information, upload official transcripts and supporting documents, and submit
Log onto the China Scholarship Council system at http://www.campuschina.org, complete and submit, and save the completed form for a later step
Apply only once at PKU - the single PKU application is considered for multiple scholarship categories
official.application_route: First submit the self-funded graduate application, then complete the PKU scholarship form in the PKU International Student Service System and the CSC form at campuschina.org; both are required for the Type B government scholarship.
official.study_mode: Full-time graduate study (master's 2-3 years; doctoral 4-5 years)
official.citizenship_residency: International students meeting Peking University's admission requirements for international students; applicants must not be candidates in a joint training programme
official.international_eligibility: Yes - the programme is for international students applying to Peking University graduate programmes
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: The CSC system allows only one major per applicant; where multiple majors are applied for in the PKU system, the major selected in the CSC system is the one on which the award is evaluated
official.duration: Master's degree: 2-3 years. Doctoral degree: 4-5 years. Renewable on an annual basis provided the holder passes the annual scholarship review.
official.description: The Chinese Government Scholarship for Advanced Graduate Program is a merit-based award from the China Scholarship Council for international students with outstanding academic backgrounds, awarded through Peking University under Type B. The published scope is a full or partial tuition waiver, living stipend, housing and medical insurance, for 2-3 years at master's level and 4-5 years at doctoral level.
official.program_type: Chinese Government Scholarship (Advanced Graduate Program), Type B university-nomination category, awarded through Peking University

travel_coverage (travel is not part of the published scope; the published scope list contains no travel component)

applicant_utility.summary: This award runs on two systems, not one: you must file the PKU scholarship form in the Peking University International Student Service System and separately complete the CSC form at campuschina.org, and missing either forfeits the scholarship. Because the waiver can be only partial, treat the tuition number as uncertain until your offer letter arrives, and secure your self-funded graduate application first since scholarship eligibility depends on it. Your single PKU application is automatically considered for three scholarships, but the CSC form forces you to pick one major, and that choice is the one your award will be evaluated on.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Strong international graduate applicants who already plan to fund a self-funded PKU application and can complete two coordinated online forms in the same January-March window.
application_readiness_checklist: Submit the full-time self-funded international graduate application first - the scholarship form presupposes it
Complete the PKU scholarship form in the International Student Service System before the PKU deadline (9:00 a.m. Beijing Time in the 2026 cycle)
Complete the CSC form at campuschina.org before its later deadline (24:00 Beijing Time in the 2026 cycle) and save the completed form
Use institution code 10001 and programme type Type B, and settle your single CSC major before submitting
Download the Certificate for CSC Advanced Graduate Program Application (item 6) from the Application Status page once available (from 25 February in the 2026 cycle)
common_rejection_risks: Filing only the PKU form and never completing the CSC form, which the notice says forfeits eligibility
Selecting a different major in the CSC system than in the PKU system, since the award is evaluated on the CSC-selected major
Holding any other Chinese government or PKU scholarship other than a one-time non-renewable merit award
Being a candidate in a joint training programme, which is excluded
Submitting false or invalid materials, which the notice says leads to disqualification and in severe cases revocation of admission
Treating any interim processing record in the CSC system as an admission result - only the PKU Admission Letter counts
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The published scope is a full or partial tuition waiver plus living stipend, housing and medical insurance; the amount, the share of tuition waived and any fees or travel are not published, so applicants should budget as if a significant cost share may remain.
document_audit: Item 6 of the CSC materials - the Certificate for CSC Advanced Graduate Program Application - can only be downloaded from the PKU system's Application Status page after a certain date, so do not leave the CSC form to the last day
If CSC material items 11 and 12 do not apply to you, you must instead submit the Foreigner Physical Examination Statement and the signed No Criminal Record Self-Declaration
Official transcripts of all past educational experience must be uploaded in the PKU system - no mailing of materials is required, but the university may demand originals later
Supplementary materials requested by the university must arrive by the deadline or the application is deemed abandoned
alerts: One PKU application covers three scholarship categories automatically - do not submit more than one, and only one scholarship will be awarded
The award is renewed annually only if you pass the annual scholarship review
The notice is cycle-specific: the 2026 dates have passed and no 2027 notice was published as at 10 October 2026, so watch the PKU scholarship notices page from January
Final decisions are communicated by email around July and August for the 2026 cycle
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Self-funded graduate application first, then the PKU scholarship form in the International Student Service System, then the CSC form at campuschina.org; the single PKU application is auto-considered for CGS/PKUS/BGS and the final award is confirmed by the PKU Admission Letter.
